purpose: Static stylized-inspired scene-supporting prop for an imaginative world aimed at young children; artistic interpretation is welcome. No strict scientific reconstruction, animation readiness or current-museum integration is claimed.

subject.life_stage: stylized representative form, not an exact life-stage reconstruction
subject.era_and_locality: Middle Cambrian, Burgess Shale, British Columbia
subject.pose: Static near-neutral suspended pose, separated appendages; no skeletal animation.

claim_scope: Named-taxon-inspired original art, with recognizable basic form. Color, texture, appealing pose, proportion exaggeration and harmless fine-detail changes are artistic choices. If the form becomes too loose for the named identity, use the descriptive generic fallback instead.
coverage_justification: Environment-prop tier uses six meaningful views at normal supported viewing scale. Add one or two targeted detail/alternate-side views only for an actual concern; a full orbit, bottom/wire set and microscopic refinement are not default obligations.
budget_context: Pilot hard ceilings, not triangle targets or a performance guarantee. Aim for deliberate economical form; record actual source/evaluated/exported counts. Any ceiling adjustment must be named and versioned before accepting.
surface_profile: refined low-poly with original artistic color/texture/roughness; use an economical original baked texture where it helps, but do not create invisible microdetail or extra material complexity merely to satisfy a style label

scale.certainty: approximate art-direction scale informed by cited form; inspect actual export bounds
scale.origin: ground/root contact center for plant; body center mounting point for suspended aquatic/insect assets
scale.coordinate_system: author Z-up and -Y forward; exported glTF Y-up and +Z forward

scene_profile.scope: neutral original static-prop benchmark; eventual cross-period imaginative-world curation is allowed when labeled, without a scientific coexistence claim
scene_profile.runtime: pin actual Three.js/browser/renderer/device in evidence; do not infer hardware performance from a parser

artistic_choices_and_uncertainties: Muted translucent-looking ochre/brown is artistic, but use opaque portable materials in this pilot to avoid untested transparency.
Nominal 0.08 m body length is an approximate upper-size-informed design scale, not a measurement of every specimen.
Fine setae and tiny mouthparts can be simplified. Do not claim a modern shrimp identity, complete appendage-level anatomical certification or a measured swimming gait.

User-approved creative scope: appealing colors, textures, pose, proportion exaggeration and harmless fine details may be artistic; retain basic recognizable structure. Cross-period curation is allowed in the labeled imaginative world.

criteria.description: Exact standalone GLB validates, reimports cleanly, has no missing dependencies or nonfinite geometry, keeps meter scale and meets hard artifact limits; warnings have asset-specific dispositions.

Recognizable basic form and the three frozen gross structures at normal supported viewing size, with no obvious accidental missing/extra limbs, detached parts or conspicuous unintended penetration. Artistic exaggeration and fine surface differences are allowed.

Stylized-inspired identity check, not strict fossil certification: Read as a small bilaterally organized arthropod: two stalked eyes and one pair of elongate antennules at the head, with a compact bivalved carapace over the anterior region. Exact proportions, fossil-unknown details and creative surfaces may differ when labeled; reject only a clear defining-structure mistake or misleading claim.

Stylized-inspired identity check, not strict fossil certification: Keep visible lamellar/limb structures under the anterior body, followed by a ringed abdomen without walking legs. The appendage region must not become an amorphous solid block. Exact proportions, fossil-unknown details and creative surfaces may differ when labeled; reject only a clear defining-structure mistake or misleading claim.

Stylized-inspired identity check, not strict fossil certification: Terminate the abdomen in paired caudal flaps; keep carapace, free abdomen and tail visibly distinct at the supported view scale. Exact proportions, fossil-unknown details and creative surfaces may differ when labeled; reject only a clear defining-structure mistake or misleading claim.

Editable blend, reproducible generator/config, standalone GLB, original maps where used, exact hashes, six-view QA evidence, one poster, provenance and honest stylized-inspired static-prop labels. No animation-ready or strict scientific-accuracy claim.
The exact GLB parses with the pinned target loader; bounds, material/texture metrics and scene identity are recorded.

Inspect the exact GLB in a declared actual graphics runtime, including normal and closest supported views. Record renderer/device and errors; software fallback is labeled and cannot claim target hardware validation.

Inspect a neutral representative prop test stage with normal/stress visible copy counts, recorded frame/work metrics and sensible contact/material behavior. This is not current-museum integration or a coexistence reconstruction.
Small color/roughness and facet variation may remain as documented advisories after the bounded cosmetic pass.
